title: Fed by one side, praising the other
literal_meaning: Eats from the Kuru side; sings of the Pandavas.
meaning_odia: ଖାଇବା ବା ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଗୋଟିଏ ପକ୍ଷଠାରୁ ମିଳୁଛି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଗୁଣଗାନ ହେଉଛି ଅନ୍ୟ ପକ୍ଷର। ଯେଉଁଠୁ ସମର୍ଥନ ମିଳେ ଓ ଯାହା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରଶଂସା କରାଯାଏ, ସେ ଦୁଇଟିର ଅମେଳକୁ ଏହି କଥା ଦେଖାଏ।
explanation: Food comes from one side, while the song goes to the other. Read as praise, the singing creates a pointed contrast between the source of someone’s support and the side they publicly favour. The inspected parallel makes a similar contrast using fighting for the other side.
usage_example: One group supplies everything needed for an event, but the organiser publicly credits its rival. A member of the supporting group uses the saying to point out the mismatch. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The Kuru side and the Pandavas supply the opposing names from the Mahabharata. Eating and singing compress material support and public praise into a short contrast, without naming the person whose loyalties are being questioned.

witnesses.note: Inspected17November2026. Upload reads କାଉଛି and separates ପାଣ୍ଡବ ଙ୍କର. Display conjecturally repairs କାଉଛି to ଖାଉଛି and joins the latter word; raw text is retained in research. No exact independent witness confirms this full display.
Parallel wording: ଖାଆନ୍ତି କୁରୁବଳଙ୍କର ଯୁଝନ୍ତି ପାଣ୍ଡବଙ୍କର. Uses eating/fighting rather than eating/singing, so supports the contrast and repair without attesting the full displayed form.

origin_note: Based on the uploaded compilation with one labelled conjectural repair; an inspected public parallel uses different verbs. Earliest origin and compilation lineage unknown.
rights_note: Source quotations are excluded from the collection CC licence; no open licence for the compilations has been established. Translation, explanation and illustrative example are newly written Project Odisha commentary.

graphic.alt: A speaker gestures toward a group on the right while people with sacks, produce and cooking pots stand behind him on the left.
graphic.caption: An imagined public address sends praise toward one group while provision comes from another.

odia_summary: ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ଗୋଟିଏ ପକ୍ଷରୁ, ଗୁଣଗାନ ଅନ୍ୟ ପକ୍ଷର।
english_summary: Receiving support from one side while praising the other.
